findings.title: SEC-001: Missing Content-Security-Policy header remains (reaudit confirmation)
findings.evidence_snippet:
<!-- index.html:4-15 -- no CSP meta tag present -->
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>EOH 2026 Contest Judging</title>
    <base href="/" />
    ...
</head>
findings.remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy meta tag with directives appropriate for Blazor WASM: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:;

findings.title: SEC-002: Insecure Random still used in PartitionService default constructor
findings.rule_violated: CWE-338 Use of Cryptographically Weak PRNG
findings.remediation: Replace new Random() in default constructor with RandomNumberGenerator-based shuffling, or use Random.Shared with documentation acknowledging non-cryptographic use.

findings.title: SEC-003: Hardcoded connection string remains — now in 3 locations
findings.rule_violated: Hardcoded configuration values should be externalized
findings.remediation: Move database path to a single configuration source (appsettings.json or constant). Remove default parameters to force explicit configuration.

findings.title: SEC-004: Database backup still lacks integrity verification (magic header only)
findings.rule_violated: CWE-345 Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
findings.remediation: Append an HMAC-SHA256 or SHA-256 checksum to the backup payload before base64 encoding. Verify on restore and reject if integrity check fails.

findings.title: SEC-005: Exception message exposure fixed (reaudit confirmation)
findings.rule_violated: CWE-209 Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

findings.title: SEC-006: Missing *.db pattern in .gitignore remains
findings.evidence_snippet:
// .gitignore has *.dbmdl (line 244) but no *.db or *.sqlite pattern.
// Application creates contest.db as its SQLite database file.
findings.rule_violated: Database files containing contest data should not be committed to version control

findings.title: SEC-007: No authentication on administrative operations remains (deferred)
findings.rule_violated: CWE-306 Missing Authentication for Critical Function
findings.remediation: Add passphrase gate on Setup page or document trusted-device deployment model. Deferred per original remediation plan.

findings.title: SEC-008: Client-side SQLite architecture unchanged (still informational)
findings.evidence_snippet:
// Program.cs:21 — SQLite initializes in browser WebAssembly
SQLitePCL.Batteries_V2.Init();
findings.rule_violated: Blazor WASM runs entirely client-side; all data is accessible via browser DevTools
findings.remediation: Document the trust model. If data confidentiality is needed, implement a backend API with server-side persistence.

findings.title: Hardcoded database path now duplicated in 3 code locations
findings.rule_violated: Duplicate hardcoded values create maintenance risk and inconsistent configuration
findings.remediation: Introduce a single configuration value (from appsettings.json or a shared constant) used by all three sites.

findings.title: DatabaseBackupService lacks path canonicalization
findings.rule_violated: CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory
findings.remediation: Add _dbPath = Path.GetFullPath(dbPath); and optionally validate the resolved path is within an expected directory.

findings.title: Schema version check in BackupService bypassable via localStorage tampering
findings.rule_violated: CWE-345 Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
findings.remediation: Combine schema version and data into a single signed/checksummed payload, or accept that localStorage is inherently untrusted in a WASM application.

scan_coverage.input_validation: adequate (ID length checks, null checks, data annotations)
scan_coverage.information_leakage: SEC-005 fixed; ILogger structured logging in place
scan_coverage.nuget_cves: none detected (manual review of recent .NET 10 preview versions)
